name: Draft2Publish – AI Content Writer, Autoblogger & Image Generator
author: Draft2Publish-AI

sections.description:
Draft2Publish is an AI content writer and autoblogger for WordPress. It researches topics, writes complete articles, optimizes for SEO and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), creates featured images, and publishes using your own Google Gemini API key. No token markup.

Use Quick Generate for one article at a time, or configure the Content Schedule to generate articles through WordPress Cron. Articles are saved as drafts or sent to pending review so you stay in control before anything goes live. Automatic publishing is available in Draft2Publish Pro.

Unlike simple AI text tools, Draft2Publish performs Deep Research first, finding real facts, citations, and content gaps before writing a single word.

Key Features

  • Bring Your Own Gemini Key: Use your own Google Gemini API key. No token markup from us.
  • Gemini-Powered Workflow: Choose between Gemini 2.5 Flash, 2.5 Pro, 3 Flash, or 3 Pro for research and writing.
  • Flexible Word Count: Generate articles from 700 to 1,000 words with a simple slider (Pro extends this to 2,500).
  • Review-First Publishing: Save as Draft or Pending Review, per article or globally. Automatic publishing is a Pro feature.
  • Fact-Based Writing: Generates structured articles with headings, lists, references, and source citations.
  • Featured Image Support: Automatically generates one featured image per article through Google’s image endpoint.
  • Weekly Content Scheduling: Configure up to 3 scheduled days per week with per-day content types, times, and categories (Pro unlocks all 7 days and multiple articles per day).
  • Google Search Grounding: Research uses real-time Google search for fact-checked, sourced content.

Optimized for AI Search (GEO)

Draft2Publish does not only write for Google Search. It structures articles for answer engines such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini too. Every article is built for Generative Engine Optimization:

  • Answer-first structure: Direct answers under question-style headings, the format AI engines can quote.
  • FAQ-ready content: Question and answer blocks that can support schema-friendly pages.
  • Citations built in: Real sources and references for trust signals readers and search engines can evaluate.
  • Full on-page SEO: Meta title, description, slug, tags, excerpt, and article structure prepared automatically.

Learn more at draft2publish.ai.

Free vs Pro

The free version is fully functional: scheduled AI draft generation, deep research with real sources, SEO/GEO optimization, and featured images — with up to 3 scheduled days per week, one article per day, 700-1,000 words, saved as Draft or Pending Review, using your own Gemini key.

Draft2Publish Pro (in-plugin upgrade) adds:
* All 7 scheduled days and multiple articles per day
* Automatic publishing (publish or schedule articles without manual review)
* Long-form articles up to 2,500 words
* Additional AI providers and model options
* Priority support and roadmap access

Perfect For

  • Bloggers who want to maintain a consistent publishing schedule
  • Marketers building authority sites with E-E-A-T structure
  • Agencies managing multiple client websites
  • Publishers scaling content production

How It Works

  1. Research: Draft2Publish uses Google Search Grounding to find real, verified facts.
  2. Write: Gemini generates a complete article with structure, citations, and references.
  3. Publish: WordPress receives a post with your selected status, featured image, tags, and metadata.

Service Disclosure

This plugin relies on the Google Gemini API (a third-party service) to function.

  • Service Name: Google Gemini API (via Google AI Studio or Vertex AI)
  • Service URL: https://ai.google.dev/
  • Terms of Service: https://ai.google.dev/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

How it works:
1. You must provide your own Google API key in the plugin settings.
2. When you click “Generate” or run scheduled generation, the plugin sends your selected topic, keywords, and configuration to Google’s Gemini endpoint.
3. Google processes this data to generate article text and optional featured image data, which is sent back to your WordPress site.
4. No other site data, user data, or traffic data is shared with Google.

Data Sent to Google:
– Article topic/title
– Keywords and category
– Word count preferences
– Writing style preferences
– Image generation prompts (for featured images)

Data Received from Google:
– Generated article content
– Research findings and sources
– Suggested titles and headings
– Generated images (base64-encoded, saved to the Media Library)

Freemius (licensing and upgrades): This plugin uses the Freemius SDK to power the optional in-dashboard account, upgrade, and license features. Freemius does not collect any data unless you explicitly opt in; you can skip the opt-in screen and use the plugin normally. See the Freemius privacy policy at https://freemius.com/privacy/.

Other than the Google Gemini API above and the optional Freemius opt-in, no data is sent to any third-party service.

Privacy Policy

Draft2Publish does not collect, store, or transmit any user data except:
1. The content you explicitly choose to generate (topics, keywords)
2. Your API keys (stored securely in your WordPress database)
3. Basic security/abuse-prevention logs (IP address and user agent) when security logging is enabled in the plugin, used only to detect and prevent unauthorized access attempts.

All AI processing in this Lite build happens through your own API keys with Google Gemini. We never see or store your generated content.

Support

  • Free users: Community support via WordPress.org forums
  • Pro users: Priority email support at support@draft2publish.ai
  • Documentation: https://draft2publish.ai/docs

Credits

Built by the Draft2Publish team.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/draft2publish directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to the “D2P” menu in your WordPress admin.
  4. Navigate to the “API Keys” tab.
  5. Enter your Google Gemini API key (get one at https://ai.google.dev/).
  6. Start generating high-quality, fact-checked articles.
sections.faq:
Is this an AI content writer or an autoblogger?

Both. Use Quick Generate as an AI content writer for one-off articles, or use Content Schedule to automate recurring article generation through WordPress Cron.

Can it auto-publish articles?

Yes. In the free version, choose Draft or Pending Review as the default status so you can review AI-assisted content before it goes live. Automatic publishing is available in Draft2Publish Pro.

Do I need my own API key?

Yes. The WordPress.org version runs on your own Google Gemini API key. You pay Google directly for any API usage, and Draft2Publish adds no token markup.

How many articles can I generate?

The free scheduler ships with up to 3 scheduled days per week, one article per day, and Quick Generate for one-off articles. The plugin never stops working or locks you out based on usage; your practical API usage depends on your own Google Gemini quota (see https://ai.google.dev/pricing). Draft2Publish Pro unlocks all 7 days and multiple articles per day.

What article length can I generate?

The free version includes 700 to 1,000 word controls for generated articles. Draft2Publish Pro extends this to 2,500 words for long-form content.

What is GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)?

GEO means structuring content so AI answer engines can understand, summarize, and cite it. Draft2Publish uses answer-first sections, question-style headings, FAQ-ready blocks, and source references.

Does the free WordPress.org version support ChatGPT or Claude?

No. The free version is Gemini-only. Draft2Publish Pro (available as an in-plugin upgrade) adds expanded provider and model options.

Will Google penalize AI-generated content?

Google Search focuses on helpful, high-quality content, regardless of how it is produced. However, using automation mainly to manipulate rankings can violate spam policies. Draft2Publish helps with research, citations, structure, and review workflows, but you should still verify facts and add your own expertise before publishing important content.

Does it support featured images?

Yes. The plugin can automatically generate and attach one featured image per article using Google’s image endpoint.

Can I schedule posts for future dates?

Yes. The Content Schedule tab lets you configure per-day content types, publish times, and categories. Articles are generated through WordPress Cron at your scheduled times.

Do I need coding knowledge?

No. Everything works through a point-and-click interface in your WordPress admin.

Will this work with my theme?

Yes. Draft2Publish generates standard WordPress posts that work with any theme.

Is the content unique?

Yes. Every article is generated fresh based on your topic, keywords, settings, and available research context.
sections.changelog:
1.0.2

  • Free/Pro editions: free version focuses on review-first drafting (up to 3 scheduled days per week, one article per day, 700-1,000 words, draft or pending review status)
  • Added optional in-dashboard account and upgrade pages powered by Freemius (opt-in, skippable)
  • Redesigned dashboard: statuspage-style status card with 14-day health bars
  • Live generation progress strip with per-step fill bar and completion toast
  • Token usage tracking: daily Gemini token totals shown on the dashboard
  • Sources-verified counter for scheduled articles
  • This Week’s Schedule widget with per-day content type and time tiles
  • Admin submenu flyout with deep links to each tab
  • More reliable next-run scheduling (fixed off-by-one when a day’s slot had passed)
  • Adaptive research retry for low-source topics and stricter article title validation
  • Hardened HTTP: TLS certificate verification on all API calls

1.0.1

  • Updated WordPress compatibility to 7.0
  • Refreshed plugin listing copy, FAQ, and screenshot captions
  • Added GEO positioning and AI-search optimization copy

1.0.0

  • Initial release of Draft2Publish for WordPress.org
  • Gemini-powered AI content automation (2.5 Flash, 2.5 Pro, 3 Flash, 3 Pro)
  • Articles from 700 to 2,500 words with flexible publish status
  • Weekly content scheduling with per-day configuration
  • Featured image generation via Gemini/Imagen
  • Google Search Grounding for fact-based research
  • About tab with feature summary and Google API key link
